title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
Oil -4.87% (24h) → $81.96 (partially recovered from $75.79 Aug-6 crash low).
Senate shelves Clarity Act for Aug recess — vote pushed to Sept 14+; near-term regulatory catalyst removed for crypto.
Tether Hadron expands into Saudi Arabia for institutional real estate tokenization (RWA scope widens).
